name: Melbourne Theatre Company concession rush and day seats
summary: Concession prices, day seats and a concession rush at MTC for full-time students with valid ID.
key: Day seats for full-time student ID holders are from only $20.
who: Full-time students with valid ID (also pensioners, the unemployed and MEAA members).
how: Day seats: buy between 9am and 12pm on the day from the theatre box office.
Concession rush: buy from the box office two hours before the performance.
catches: Some Premium productions have no concession rush; phone 8688 0800 to check.
Parts of this page refer to 2019, so confirm day seats still run.

source.label: Melbourne Theatre Company: Ticket Prices and Discounts

evidence.quote: Concession prices are available for Pensioners, Full-Time Students and the unemployed with a valid ID, for most MTC shows.
Pensioner Concession Card, full time student ID or MEAA membership, from only $20.
When available they can be purchased from the relevant theatre box office two hours prior to each performance.
